title: Material and Defocus Cues for Occluded Object Localization in Single Hyperspectral Images: An Exploratory Study

problem.summary: Hyperspectral imaging provides material-dependent spectra and wavelength-dependent optical blur, which offer complementary evidence for separating objects.
statements: Hyperspectral imaging provides material-dependent spectra and wavelength-dependent optical blur, which offer complementary evidence for separating objects.
We investigate a pipeline that combines nonnegative-matrix-factorization-based material grouping, divergence-based optical cues, and graph Laplacian propagation.
The propagated scores support region extraction and bounding-box localization without requiring a separate depth sensor at inference.
